messages.subject: Shinyapps.io Service Outage
parts:
Hello,
The shinyapps.io service suffered an outage last night. The issue has since been resolved as of this morning at noon (EST).  The problem was caused by an automatic update of a package on our load balancers which caused our load balancers to intermittently fail. We have eliminated the automatic updates and added additional monitoring to alert us of these conditions in the future.   If you are still seeing any issues with the service, please don't hesitate to reach out.
Apologies for the disruption and thank you for your patience with us.

--Chad Barraford
Software Engineer @ RStudio
